== English Virtual Original comparison ==
May’s published bar has no Armor. The archived June 19 edition adds printed Armor 3 and the August and February revisions independently confirm it. The later face keeps Armor 3, underlying pilot icon, all stats and gameplay clauses, with wording reordered. There are two gameplay states across three publications. The existing article named Remastered 2006 is the 1105_8o2 June textual record with its correct current navigation label but late artwork, while the short title holds 1105_8 and actual 2006. Exact June File exists.
